Dear [Mr Wooldridge](/person/2094),
I think it will be wise to keep up the insurance on [Mrs Yonge](/person/1604)’s life.

The only further question is whether it should be mentioned in my will that the payment should be continued, and to whom the amount should be paid.

On this I will write to [Mr Houseman](/person/2146) who made my will.
I enclose the cheque for the insurance understanding that it covers all the houses here and in London

Yours truly

C M Yonge
